description: This file defines the GuzzleHandler class responsible for sending PSR-7 compatible HTTP requests using Guzzle 5. It manages request creation, handling options, and adapting responses between Guzzle versions.

classes.name: GuzzleHandler
classes.description: A request handler that bridges PSR-7 requests with Guzzle 5, returning Guzzle promises adapted for PSR-7 responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with an optional Guzzle client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a PSR-7 request by creating and sending a Guzzle 5 request, returning a promise that resolves with a PSR-7 response.

methods.name: createGuzzleRequest
methods.description: Creates a Guzzle 5 request from a PSR-7 request, handling various options and configurations.

methods.name: createPsr7Response
methods.description: Converts a Guzzle 5 response into a PSR-7 response.

methods.name: prepareErrorData
methods.description: Prepares structured error data from exceptions encountered during request handling.
